summary: The common-coordinate midpoint map follows exactly from the accepted p- and q-coordinate conventions and the survivor values. The listed endpoint pairs reproduce all twenty displayed vertices, their edge directions form the exact merged cyclic edge sequence of the two accepted decagons, and the stated clipping intersections and shoelace area are exact. The positive-area first-quadrant portion of B lies, up to cutting-line boundaries, in the unsupported strict middle cell R_k, so any convex K containing B contradicts the prescribed zero area of R_k.
